rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by The Spotted Cat Music Club. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: There's a one-drink minimum. The bar serves cocktails, mocktails, beer and non-alcoholic sodas and juices.
concessions.quote: ONE DRINK MINIMUM // 21 years old & over only

ticketPickup.summary: No tickets or reservations are needed, and tables are first come, first served. The club is strictly 21 and over, and under 21 can't enter for any reason. Bring a valid US photo ID or foreign passport, since photos of IDs aren't accepted.
ticketPickup.quote: Valid US Photo ID & Foreign Passports Required for Entry

gates.summary: The Spotted Cat is open seven days a week from 2 PM to 2 AM, though times can change without notice.
